description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Feature' within the 'PdfSharp.Quality' namespace, providing methods for rendering code snippets and handling PDF document creation, saving, and reading. It is part of the PDFsharp library, focusing on features related to PDF processing.

classes.name: Feature
classes.description: An abstract base class for features in the PDFsharp quality module, providing utility methods for PDF rendering, creation, and file management.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPdf
methods.description: Renders a code snippet to PDF using default dimensions and saves/show the file.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPdf
methods.description: Renders a code snippet to PDF with specified dimensions, graphics unit, and page direction, then saves/show the file.

methods.name: RenderAllSnippets
methods.description: Virtual method intended to render all snippets; does nothing in the base class.

methods.name: CreateNewPdfDocument
methods.description: Creates a new PDF document with preset title, subject, and layout.

methods.name: SaveToStreamOrSaveToFile
methods.description: Saves a PDF document to a stream or file, optionally showing the document.

methods.name: SaveAndShowDocument
methods.description: Saves the PDF document and opens it for viewing.

methods.name: SaveDocument
methods.description: Saves the PDF document to a specified filename or path.

methods.name: ReadWritePdfDocument
methods.description: Reads an existing PDF and writes it to a new file, optionally using a password provider.
